Typography

The M3 type scale has 15 standard roles (display, headline, title, body, label — each large/medium/small), each encoding font-size, line-height, weight, and tracking via --md-sys-typescale-* tokens. The bridge maps every role to a Tailwind utility. Each row below shows its font-size / line-height · weight from the tokens.
